description: PATCH /v1/merchants/me - updates the business name, the settlement policy, the processing settings and/or the account-level service-fee payer; each field is independent, send only what changes. Setting the name for the first time flips onboardingCompleted to true. Settlement and processing changes decide where and in what asset the merchant is paid - confirm with the user before changing them. They apply to sessions created afterwards, except underpaymentToleranceBps, which also applies to sessions that are still open. The profile email is not updatable: it is taken from the verified thirdweb login email and never overwritten. Requires a fresh JWT.

name.description: Business name shown to payers on the checkout page.

normalizePayoutAddress.description: Recipient of the unstaked USDe; null returns to the merchant wallet. Every later payment in those modes goes to this address.

normalizePayoutChainId.description: Chain the unstaked USDe is delivered on (a supported chain id); null returns to the default destination. Steers NORMALIZE and below-threshold THRESHOLD payments only.

processingExpenseLimitBps.description: Largest processing price the merchant covers, in basis points of the order amount (300 = 3%).

processingPaymentMode.description: Who covers a payment option's processing price: MERCHANT_ONLY takes it from the proceeds up to processingExpenseLimitBps and does not offer pricier options; PAYER_ONLY adds it to the amount the payer sends; MERCHANT_THEN_PAYER covers it within the limit and charges the payer above it.

serviceFeePayer.description: Account-level service-fee payer: MERCHANT withholds the fee from proceeds, PAYER adds it to the payer's amount due. New sessions inherit it unless sessions_create overrides it.

stakingMode.description: Settlement policy for new sessions: ALWAYS swaps every payment to USDe and stakes it into sUSDe; THRESHOLD stakes payments at or above stakingThresholdUsd and keeps smaller ones as liquid USDe; NORMALIZE swaps every payment to USDe and delivers it unstaked; NEVER delivers the token that was paid, on the chain it arrived on, with no swap.

stakingThresholdUsd.description: Positive USD decimal string. Required when the mode becomes THRESHOLD and no threshold is stored; every other mode clears it and refuses a value.

underpaymentToleranceBps.description: A payment this many basis points under the amount still counts as paid: 0 requires the full amount, 100 accepts up to 1% under.
